gloss: self-destructive; reckless despair; giving up on oneself

definitions.explanation: A state of having lost hope and acting recklessly without caring about consequences, often damaging oneself in the process.

examples.japanese: {失恋|しつれん}して{自暴自棄|じぼうじき}になる。
examples.english: To become self-destructive after a broken heart.

examples.japanese: {自暴自棄|じぼうじき}になっても{何|なに}も{解決|かいけつ}しない。
examples.english: Nothing is solved by giving in to despair.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{仕事|しごと}を{失|うしな}って{自暴自棄|じぼうじき}な{行動|こうどう}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: He lost his job and started acting recklessly out of despair.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}):
{自暴|じぼう} (self-abandonment) + {自棄|じき} (giving up on oneself)

COMPONENTS:
- {自|じ}: self
- {暴|ぼう}: violence, recklessness
- {棄|き}: to abandon, to discard

GRAMMAR:
Used as a na-adjective with になる or as a noun:
- {自暴自棄|じぼうじき}になる (to become self-destructive)
- {自暴自棄|じぼうじき}な{行動|こうどう} (self-destructive behavior)

NUANCE:
Describes someone who has lost all hope and no longer cares about the consequences of their actions, often leading to harmful behavior.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {やけになる}: to become desperate/reckless
- {投|な}げやりになる}: to become careless/indifferent
- {諦|あきら}める: to give up
